checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before

checks.label: consolidation quality

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

plan.limit_note: the ticket's limit is $61.38: the $62.80 day-2 ceiling (the close +4%) narrowed to the highest price at which the bar's midpoint $58.93 is still inside his 4% line
plan.pre_open_check: before the open: if the pre-market print is under $59.17 the burst is failing, over $62.80 (+4%) day 2 is spent, and over $65.21 (+8%) he would be selling; do not place the order in any of the three. The ticket's own limit is $61.38, under that day-2 line: an open above it does not fill at the open, though a resting order stays live
plan.planned_entry_note: an indicative entry, the close plus 1%, that the exit levels and targets are quoted from; not a fill, and not the sizing price
plan.sizing_note: sized at the $61.38 limit, the highest fill the ticket permits: 15 shares put $36.75 between that fill and the $58.93 stop, planned price-to-stop risk, not a maximum loss
plan.resize_rule: if your fill differs, shares = $37.50 / (fill - $58.93), and no more than $7,500.00 of stock
plan.stop_risk_reason: the stop is 3.99% under the ticket's limit, the highest fill it permits: inside his 4% line, wider than his ideal 2%, so the risk is multiplied by 0.5

targets.note: above $40 he measures the move in dollars: $5-25

exits.when: same or next day, the price reaches $65.86 (+8% from $60.98)
exits.rule: sell half and move the stop to 25-50 cents under that day's high

exits.when: any single day closes at or above $67.08 (+10%)
exits.rule: take at least partial profit and move the stop up to protect the rest

exits.when: it opens at or above $73.18 (+20%) after entry

exits.rule: the stop rises to the entry day's low if that is above $58.93
sell at least half at the close
raise the stop to each day's low (it never moves down)

exits.when: the protective stop at $58.93 is a stop-market order, live intraday from the moment the buy fills
exits.rule: if it is somehow not filled, exit on any close below it

do not move the stop to break-even before day 5 just because it is green (theStrat Lab EP9M backtest: the win rate collapses from 29.8% to 7.25%; delaying to day 5 restores it); the +8% raise above is a different rule

plan.order_line: Buy 15 RCBC stop-limit: stop $60.38 limit $61.38, day · OTO sell 15 RCBC stop-loss $58.93 GTC
plan.order_readback: Buy 15 RCBC stop limit 60.38 / 61.38 day, one-triggers-the-other sell 15 RCBC stop loss 58.93 GTC
order_terms: A day order rests until the close unless you cancel it. The plan's entry is the first 30 minutes: if it has not filled by then, cancel it yourself; SpicyStock places and cancels nothing.
An open above the $61.38 limit does not fill at the open, but the resting order stays live and can fill on a pullback under $61.38 later in the day: cancel it rather than let it.
An open under $59.17 is the burst failing: do not place the order, or cancel it; the buy stop at $60.38 would still trigger if the price recovered.
The sell stop at $58.93 is attached the moment the buy fills (OTO), as a stop-market order; nothing is protected before the fill.
notes: the stop is 3.99% under the ticket's limit, the highest fill it permits: inside his 4% line, wider than his ideal 2%, so the risk is multiplied by 0.5

exit_schedule.instruction: buy in the first 30 minutes inside $59.17–$61.38; the sell stop at $58.93 is live from the fill. Skip it if it opens above $62.80 or under $59.17; cancel the day order yourself if it has not filled by the end of the first 30 minutes.
if same or next day, the price reaches $65.86 (+8% from $60.98): sell half and move the stop to 25-50 cents under that day's high.
at the close of day 1: the stop rises to the entry day's low if that is above $58.93.
if day 2 is green: do not move the stop to break-even before day 5 just because it is green.
at the day 3 close: sell at least half at the close. If day 3 closes at or below $60.98: exit: no follow-through.
raise the stop to each day's low (it never moves down); sell the rest into strength.
at the day 5 close: exit the remainder into strength.

claude.reason: The chart shows a clean, persistent stair-step advance from August through late October with no visible breakouts before this signal, confirming the young-trend reading. The three-session base is visually tight and orderly — bars are narrow and contained just below the prior high — and the burst bar closes near its high on more than double the prior session's volume. The red dashed overhead line sits right at the burst close, so there is modest supply to absorb, but the bar itself is honest and the setup is structurally sound.
claude.key_risk: The move is 59 sessions and 28% old, and the close is 7.6% above the 20-day average, so any broad-market weakness could stall follow-through quickly.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps more than 1% above the burst close or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior base high near 59.25.
